source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if not grid:
        return out
    # The colored marker rises above its horizontal base: 2 makes a 4-cell
    # stem, while 8 makes a 3-cell stem. The marker itself is the top cell.
    base = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v in (2, 8) for v in row)), None)
    if base is None:
        return out
    for c, value in enumerate(grid[base]):
        if value in (2, 8):
            height = 4 if value == 2 else 3
            top = max(0, base - height)
            for r in range(top, base):
                out[r][c] = value if r == top else 1
    return out
'''
